content.title: 'Euphoria' Season 3 Sets HBO Release Date - IMDb
content.text: 'Euphoria' Season 3 Sets HBO Release DateIt has been four years since Euphoria Season 2 aired its finale, but HBO has finally set a release window for Season 3. Created by Sam Levinson based on the Israeli series of the same name, Euphoria follows a group of teenagers' social circles as they explore sexuality, drugs, and the hierarchy of high school.HBO announced today that Euphoria Season 3 will officially debut in April 2026. They also released an official poster for the series, showing Ruth (Zendaya) in a car with the caption "Let's Ride." Series regulars Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, Jacob Elordi, Alexa Demie, Hunter Schafer, and Maude Apatow are all set to reprise their roles.
